capabilities: Fetch macOS Calendar events for a chosen date range
Insert events as a formatted plain-text list
Trigger insertion with an inline )) autosuggest picker
Configure date, time, prefix and grouping of the output
Exclude slow or noisy calendars from fetches
disambiguation: Not a calendar view; it pastes calendar events as plain text lines into the current note.
extras: macOS only; requires installing icalBuddy once (Homebrew or manual download) and granting macOS Calendar access.README mentions actively developed and asks users to report issues on GitHub. Mentions companion plugins Date List and File Filter without defining a formal relationship.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull events from the macOS Calendar app into a note, so agendas must be copied and re-formatted by hand.

relations.evidence: Calendar List reads your calendars through a free command-line tool called icalBuddy

summary: macOS-only plugin that pulls Apple Calendar events for a chosen date range and inserts them into notes as a formatted plain-text list.
